subject.title: fix: restore trusted plugin subagent handoffs

question: Should the plugin subagent fallback trust path accept backend-mode request scopes that are not plugin HTTP routes, or should it be narrowed to a stricter internal gateway-client identity?
rationale: The PR is plausibly correct, but it changes who can receive internal allowModelOverride on a scoped client, which is an authorization boundary that automation should not silently bless without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept Backend-Scope Boundary
options.body: Land this shape after the contributor adds redacted real behavior proof for the allowed backend handoff and denied plugin HTTP route.

options.title: Narrow To Internal Identity
options.body: Require the guard to check a stricter gateway-client/internal identity if backend mode alone is not intended to carry fallback override trust.

options.title: Defer To Broader Model-Routing Work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the related model-routing authorization work consolidated with the existing open sessions_spawn fix candidate.

recommendation.title: Accept Backend-Scope Boundary
recommendation.body: Land this shape after the contributor adds redacted real behavior proof for the allowed backend handoff and denied plugin HTTP route.

likelyOwner.reason: The historical plugin subagent override policy and gateway authorization boundary trace most directly to this person’s merged feature work.
